title: Crypto24 -- File Renamed With the .crypto24 Extension
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules
description: Detects a file written with the .crypto24 suffix. Trend Micro documented that during Crypto24 encryption on victim Windows hosts "files are renamed during encryption by appending the .crypto24 extension to their original names". The extension is specific to this ransomware family, so a single write is already a strong signal; it is also a lagging one, because encryption is under way when it fires.
